_comment: Ratchet baseline for content_qa.py rule H (stat attribution, Run 1 item 1.D; lettered H because WS-4's evidence-class rule already holds G). Each entry is a pre-existing external statistic on a served/customer surface with no inline source + month/year, verified 2026-09-02 and HELD for the named owner. Keyed by (path, normalized line) so an unrelated edit does not release it; a stale row fails the scan. Only ever shrinks; never admits a new unsourced statistic.
